name: Uniswap
description: Uniswap is a decentralized exchange protocol where tokens are swapped against automated market maker (AMM) liquidity pools instead of an order book. Uniswap Labs runs the official web app, which routes trades across Uniswap v2, v3 and v4 pools on Ethereum and many layer-2 and EVM networks; liquidity providers earn swap fees and the protocol is governed by UNI holders.
description_zh: Uniswap 是一个去中心化交易所协议，用户通过自动做市商（AMM）流动性池而非订单簿兑换代币。Uniswap Labs 运营官方网页应用，可在以太坊及众多二层网络和 EVM 网络上的 Uniswap v2、v3、v4 池之间路由交易；流动性提供者赚取交易手续费，协议由 UNI 持有者治理。
repo_status: open (release mirror, dev in private repo)

geo_site.method: Code has no site-level geo-block. 2025 reports said the whole of Ukraine was blocked through 'third-party providers'

geo_feature.scope: RWA tokens, LP, migration, Toucan auctions: region gate GatedFeature.ISSUER_SPECIFIC_RWA plus per-token restriction reasons from compliance v2 (server decides by IP)

screening.provider: own compliance v2 API (entry-gateway.backend-prod.api.uniswap.org); TRM Labs historically (2022)
screening.fail_note: an unauthenticated session also counts as not-blocked

notes: Screening and the RWA gate are calls to the Uniswap entry gateway. Routing (Trading API) goes through the same gateway and needs an API key.
